mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid unemployment rate increase (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 2.0% periods, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% monthly indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1500 thousand units signals weak residential demand, reducing economic growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500.0, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) from prior month indicate broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from prior month
failure_condition: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline from prior month, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), deteriorating corporate earnings cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO decline-for-two-months periods, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
